input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: The IP allocation matches our preferred position in all respects. Section 14.1 confirms Customer owns Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and its independently developed IP, with no transfer to Vendor beyond a limited processing right to provide the Services for us (reinforced by Section 15.1, which bars sale, advertising use, data commingling and model training without our consent). Section 14.2 vests Deliverables in Customer with an express Vendor assignment, personnel assignments and further-assurance cooperation. Section 14.3 lets Vendor keep only Vendor Technology (defined at 1.11 to exclude Customer Data and our pre-existing IP) and applies the Section 13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works from any Vendor Technology embedded in a Deliverable, with disclosure of material Vendor Technology before delivery. Section 14.4 negates joint ownership absent a signed instrument specifying exploitation rights and preserves our unrestricted right to use our own feedback. No assignment of Customer IP or data to Vendor appears anywhere in the document, so no redline is required.
